notes: Measured on AE 2026 8 bpc, bit-exact on the 3 visible refs (Width slider 16 and 30, Width & Height 40x20 red at 50 %). Pattern evaluated with pixel CENTRES at integer layer coordinates (pixel i covers [i-0.5, i+0.5]: a boundary through the Anchor x = 320 half-covers pixel 320); check (floor((x-Ax)/W), floor((y-Ay)/H)) filled when the index sum is even; anti-aliasing = exact box-filter coverage, separable as (1 + <u><v>)/2 with <u> the mean of the +-1 square wave over the pixel (only half-pixel coverages are in the refs: 0.5 -> 127, 0.25*0.5 -> 63); alpha8 = floor(coverage * Opacity * 255) (AE truncates), colour (C8 * a8 + 127) div 255. Blending Mode 1 None renders ONLY the checkerboard (the layer content and its alpha are discarded, checks also fill the transparent area). Not covered by a visible ref: Size From 1 Corner Point (W, H = |Corner - Anchor|), Feather Width/Height (modelled as widening the coverage box by the feather, i.e. a linear ramp of that width across each edge), Blending Modes 2..23 (checks composited over the layer with the usual blend formulas; 19 Stencil Alpha, 20 Silhouette Alpha, 21 Alpha Add, 22 Luminescent Premul assumed from AE's 4-Color Gradient menu; the 23rd entry is unknown and treated as Normal). Points are in layer px (fxPad adds the canvas offset). AE 6 / 9 are UI group markers, 13 Compositing Options not reproduced. Rive residuals (max 1-2/255, mean <= 0.008 %) are the Rive canvas/composite +-1 noise already documented on tint/invert, not the shader.
